pairs: Sic nos existimet homo ut ministros Christi,
let man consider us to be ministers of Christ and attendants of the mysteries of God.
Hic jam quæritur inter dispensatores ut fidelis quis inveniatur.
Here and now, it is required of attendants that each one be found to be faithful.
Mihi autem pro minimo est ut a vobis judicer,
it is such a small thing to be judged by you,
or by the age of mankind.
And neither do I judge myself.
For I have nothing on my conscience.
sed non in hoc justificatus sum:
But I am not justified by this.
qui autem judicat me, Dominus est.
For the Lord is the One who judges me.
do not choose to judge before the time,
He will illuminate the hidden things of the darkness,
and he will make manifest the decisions of hearts.
et tunc laus erit unicuique a Deo.
And then each one shall have praise from God.
I have presented these things in myself and in Apollo,
that no one should be inflated against one person and for another,
unus adversus alterum infletur pro alio.
not beyond what has been written.
For what distinguishes you from another?
quid autem habes quod non accepisti?
And what do you have that you have not received?
But if you have received it,
why do you glory, as if you had not received it?
So, now you have been filled,
and now you have been made wealthy,
as if to reign without us?
But I wish that you would reign,
so that we, too, might reign with you!
Puto enim quod Deus nos Apostolos novissimos ostendit,
For I think that God has presented us as the last Apostles,
For we have been made into a spectacle for the world,
So we are fools because of Christ,
but you are discerning in Christ?
Usque in hanc horam et esurimus, et sitimus,
Even to this very hour, we hunger and thirst,
et nudi sumus, et colaphis cædimur,
and we are naked and repeatedly beaten,
tamquam purgamenta hujus mundi facti sumus,
We have become like the refuse of this world,
like the reside of everything, even until now.
I am not writing these things in order to confound you,
but in order to admonish you,
sed ut filios meos carissimos moneo.
Nam si decem millia pædagogorum habeatis in Christo,
For you might have ten thousand instructors in Christ,
Nam in Christo Jesu per Evangelium ego vos genui.
For in Christ Jesus, through the Gospel, I have begotten you.
just as I am of Christ.
For this reason, I have sent you Timothy,
qui est filius meus carissimus, et fidelis in Domino:
who is my dearest son, and who is faithful in the Lord.
He will remind you of my ways,
sicut ubique in omni ecclesia doceo.
just as I teach everywhere, in every church.
Tamquam non venturus sim ad vos, sic inflati sunt quidam.
Certain persons have become inflated in thinking that I would not return to you.
But I will return to you soon,
et cognoscam non sermonem eorum qui inflati sunt,
And I will consider, not the words of those who are inflated,
Non enim in sermone est regnum Dei,
For the kingdom of God is not in words,
Should I return to you with a rod,
